release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.9 strengthens postflop decision-making while preserving the immutable 174-scenario preflop policy. The BOT distinguishes current-board showdown value from future draw equity, protects showdown-capable hands from being repurposed as bluffs, sizes thin one-pair value bets more carefully, allows only narrow protection bets, and requires fold equity plus value-combo blockers and positional/range support for pure bluffs. Regression coverage includes full-decision SDV cases and all existing 174-chart, CPU, and updater checks.
